thread:
noah: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about hybrid/office logistics. A few folks asked for the practical bits so dropping them here.

maya: Thanks! Short answers first: 1) hoteling rules, 2) offsite budget + approvals, 3) travel reimburse timeline.

indra: Hoteling in NYC 1st floor: is adhoc check-in still allowed or do we need 24hr advance booking now? Some mornings teams are getting locked out.

maya: For NYC pilot we require >2hr advance booking for focus rooms during 8am-11am peak. Adhoc is still allowed outside peak windows. This is to reduce no-shows. If your team has recurring needs we can reserve a block (submit reservations@redwood.com).

leah: To clarify offsite funding: each org gets a baseline offsite fund calculated by headcount. Managers can request top-ups for special events (e.g. client workshops) with 2-week lead time. Offsite requests go through the same Google form used in the invite (link on the all-hands doc).

noah: Who pays for client-travel when the client hasn't budgeted it? Example: design team traveled to a prospect's site last month and it was ambiguous.

leah: Billable work -> charge client. If it's pre-sales or exploratory and not billable, use org offsite budget. If it's ambiguous, tag me and @maya and we'll route approval to Finance.

tom: Concur vs Expensely question: contractors seem confused which tool to use. Is there a contractor policy?

maya: Contractors use Expensely for reimbursable travel unless their contract explicitly states otherwise. Please include "Contractor" in the profile when submitting so Finance can route.

noah: Visa/immigration support for APAC folks attending the USA offsite? Who coordinates?

leah: Facilities coordinates with our travel vendor for paperwork and pays fees for work-related visas. DM me the names and passport expiry dates (must be >=6 months). We'll also cover expedite fees for covered attendees.

ops-bot: Reminder: Offsite RSVP + dietary needs due 2026-07-07 0:00 UTC.

indra: Are guests allowed to attend the social evening? Some managers asked about family partners.

maya: Managers may approve one guest for social events. Company covers main event ticket; guests' travel/hotel are manager/employee responsibility unless pre-approved.

tom: Any update on hybrid stipend for home office equipment? A couple of new hires asked about chairs/desks.

maya: There's a one-time hybrid stipend of $350 for home office setup, plus an ergonomic review program for folks who need equipment beyond that. Submit requests via People-ops portal.

noah: Timeline on reimbursements 1: how long after submission?

leah: Target is 7 business days after complete submission in Expensely. If missing receipts cause delays Finance will send a hold notice.

maya: Action items from this thread: Leah -> publish clarified travel/expenses FAQ and share link; Tom -> confirm contractor guidance in onboarding; Maya -> update all-hands doc with booking windows and guest policy; Indra -> send recurring room requests for design team. I'll ping when documents are live.

noah: Thanks everyone. I'll follow-up if more questions pop up. :thumbsup:
